end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of 2D shapes in different positions.
Answered 2 of 3 side-counting attempts without help.
Named shapes from their sides and corners correctly in 2 attempts.
Explained that slanted sides still count as sides; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, including shapes shown at different angles. Ayaan used the method of counting each line and each turning point, and correctly identified rectangles and triangles. They briefly mixed up where to start counting a star, then counted its three sides later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw a few triangles and rectangles in different positions and count the sides and corners aloud.
